title: I'm the Final Boss of This Town
summary: Four hundred heroes try to fight a baker’s kid, and he puts them to work. Then the priest reads his little sister’s class.
frame_0: The boy sits on Mom’s bakery step with his chin in his hand. His red bar crosses the street, heroes line up with their weapons, and Mom holds a tray in the doorway.
package_differences: Uses Jake’s November 22 sponsor update with the Flashloop code at top right, handle at top left and a five-second spoken phone ending showing this bakery’s next morning.
